description: List the obligations for a role under the EU AI Act, optionally filtered by risk tier.

limit.description: Max obligations to return (default all, hard cap 25 per call)

risk_tier.description: Filter by risk tier; "all" = no filter. Synonyms accepted.

name: get_obligations

citation.description: Clause-level citation: clause (e.g. "Article 5(1)(ba)"), the article's official heading, and the euaiactlaw.com paragraph permalink (#/article/N/<anchor>).

items.description: Clause-level citation: clause (e.g. "Article 5(1)(ba)"), the article's official heading, and the euaiactlaw.com paragraph permalink (#/article/N/<anchor>).

commencement.description: Dates from which the obligation applies (Article 113), each with its scope and legal basis

event_deadline.description: Event-based deadline (e.g. before placing on the market), separate from the commencement date; null when the obligation simply applies from its commencement date

guidance_note.description: Note on guidance, templates, codes of practice, harmonised standards or amending legislation relevant to the obligation (or on a related point of law); guidance_status gives the publication stage of its subject

guidance_status.description: Publication stage of the main subject of guidance_note, not its legal effect or applicability: published = published documents (e.g. Commission guidelines, a template, a code of practice, a Commission opinion on a code, an implementing regulation or a harmonised standard reference; the note names each); adopted_law = adopted legislation (e.g. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744; the note may also name related guidance and its stage); draft = a draft, not final, with no legal effect; pending = expected or in preparation (the note says what, if anything, is already published); info = information on a related point of law

transitions.description: Transitional compliance dates under Article 111 for systems or models already on the market
